tickerText: [TENNIS] Alexandra Eala stunned Jessica Pegula 4-6, 6-4, 6-0 for her first WTA title as Taylor Fritz beat Rafael Jodar 7-6(2), 6-4 to end his 2026 title drought at the DC Open • [SQUASH] Pakistan's Nasir Iqbal faces Egypt's Salman Khalil today in the PN Fleet Club Open final in Karachi after sweeping his semi-final in 24 minutes • [BADMINTON] BWF World Championships kick off August 17 in New Delhi as Tanvi Sharma's Taipei Open breakthrough sets the tone for India's home showcase • [PICKLEBALL] The PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open begins August 6 as the tour's Vietnam swing follows a record Singapore stop • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Yokohama opens at the BUNTAI with an all-Japan men's clash between Uda and Shinozuka and Matsushima facing Zhou Qihao on day one

newsItems.title: Eala Claims Historic DC Open
newsItems.excerpt: Alexandra Eala became the first Filipina to win a WTA singles title, rallying past Jessica Pegula 4-6, 6-4, 6-0 after rain delays in Washington.

newsItems.title: Worlds Preview: New Delhi
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 BWF World Championships run August 17–23 at Indira Gandhi Arena — India's first worlds since 2009, with Tanvi Sharma riding Taipei Open momentum.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia Heads to Vietnam
newsItems.excerpt: After a record Singapore stop, the PPA Tour Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open runs August 6–9 as the tour's international swing continues.

newsItems.title: Yokohama Opens Today
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Yokohama begins at the BUNTAI with defending champion Tomokazu Harimoto, Matsushima Sora, and an all-Japan men's opener on day one.
